create_edgelist: create an EdgeList from left and right EntityLists with a relation tensor and optional weight
concatenate_edgelists: concatenate multiple EdgeList objects into a single EdgeList using the cat class method
index_edgelist: index into an EdgeList with an int, slice, or long tensor to get a subset EdgeList
get_relation_type: get the relation type from an EdgeList as either a scalar int or a vector tensor
move_edgelist_to_device: move an EdgeList and all its tensors to a specified device using the to method
